drafts.summary: A short guided activity that helps students separate strong mathematical sources from weaker background references before they write a project plan.

drafts.title: Progress Risk Checkpoint
drafts.summary: A checkpoint prompt that asks learners to distinguish visible activity from evidence-backed project progress.
drafts.excerpt: Students inspect a progress note, identify the highest-risk gap, and justify what should be raised in the next advisor meeting.
